summary: xAI announced that its Grok 4.5 coding model is now available inside GitHub Copilot's model picker across VSCode, cloud agents and the Copilot CLI, and is also available via the SpaceXAI API at stated per-token pricing.

mechanisms.reason: Distribution into a widely used developer surface plausibly increases aggregate token volume, though no usage figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot for millions of developers who use VSCode and GitHub products every day.

practices.reason: Teams already using GitHub Copilot can switch to Grok 4.5 via the model picker with no code changes required, so this is a low-effort optional integration to be aware of.
practices.quote: From the model picker, simply pick "Grok 4.5" to start using our latest coding model.
